answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a refundable bond before earning, like a falcon tethered by its jesses: the bond returns only after a long cooldown, so a farmer spinning up thousands of identities must fund thousands of bonds at once. Payments for work flow through escrow that releases only after independent spot-checks, and the audit trail is public, so cheap ivory-tower fakes cannot hide. Honest agents earn a saffron badge of verified history that clients weight, raising the cost of abandoning a good identity and starting fresh.
